title: Wesley Gilbert
description: Personal blog, portfolio, and general forum of self-expression for Wesley J. Gilbert — semiconductor engineer at Intel, biophysicist by training, builder of open-source scientific tools.
motto: I only know that I know nothing.

about.short: Welcome to my personal blog, portfolio, and general forum of self-expression. Here you'll find my scientific interests, links to my work, and my socials.
about.extended: I'm a curious individual. I love to learn and apply what I learn to what I deem the most important problems for humanity. We live in a time where humanity has more power and responsibility than ever before. I hope to bring solutions to the existential problems stemming from this. My primary focus is human augmentation through genetic engineering, morphological manipulation, and synthetic biology.

focus_areas.title: LNP-EE-Predictor
focus_areas.description: Building on work by the LNP Atlas and LNPDB groups at the Korea Institute for Science and Technology and MIT, curating an open-source database of lipid nanoparticle formulations for ML analysis. Developing, alongside Constantinos Skevofilax, a dockerized API with pre-processing, ML training, and analysis code in Python to predict encapsulation efficiency of novel LNP formulations.

focus_areas.title: Cranio-Facial FEA
focus_areas.description: A finite element analysis model for cranio-facial bone remodeling, focused on orthotropic pressures — tongue pressure vs. mouth breathing — and their long-term morphological effects.

focus_areas.title: Disaggregated Packaging at Intel
focus_areas.description: Advanced semiconductor packaging at Intel's Fab 9 in Albuquerque. Maintenance of the singulated die sort toolset, SOP design, process health monitoring, and QMS development. Ramped module availability from ~50% to ~92% as owner of operational indicators, reduced backside mylar residue defect rate from 18% to 0% over three months, and deployed a new operational-efficiency analytics dashboard.
